title: Snapshot and Restore Order Archives
description:
**SITUATION:**

Ops is about to run a risky change against order archives. Before they touch anything, they want a **backup freeze** of the disk “as it is right now.” If the change goes badly, they want a **fresh copy** of that backup mounted somewhere safe — without destroying the original archive disk.

This lab takes a **VolumeSnapshot** of order archives and restores it to a fresh PVC. The original disk stays intact — you are proving backup/restore, not replacing production in place.

Setup already created archive claim `order-archive-pvc` on StorageClass **`gp2`** (EBS) and a small `archive-seed` Pod so the claim can **Bind** (`gp2` uses WaitForFirstConsumer). Snapshots use class `quickbyte-snapclass` (EBS CSI). **You** create the VolumeSnapshot — setup does not.

[DevSetu Blog — Volumes, PVs, PVCs, and StorageClasses](/play/devops-engineer/kubernetes/read/volumes-pvs-pvcs-storageclasses)

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Create a **VolumeSnapshot** of the current archive claim (`order-archive-pvc`).
2. Create a **new** storage claim restored from that snapshot.

> [!tip] Optional check — does not affect Submit
> You can optionally verify the snapshot is ready and the restored claim is **Bound**, for example with a tiny Pod `archive-restore-check` that mounts `order-archive-pvc-restore` at `/restore`. This is only for your own confidence. **Skip it if you want — the grader does not require this check Pod or live Bound/ready status.**

**SPEC:**

- VolumeSnapshot name: `order-archive-snap`
- `volumeSnapshotClassName`: `quickbyte-snapclass`
- Source: PVC `order-archive-pvc`
- Restored PVC name: `order-archive-pvc-restore`
- Restored PVC:
  - accessModes: `["ReadWriteOnce"]`
  - storage request: `500Mi`
  - `storageClassName`: `gp2`
  - dataSource:
    - name: `order-archive-snap`
    - kind: `VolumeSnapshot`
    - apiGroup: `snapshot.storage.k8s.io`
- Original PVC `order-archive-pvc` still exists

**GOOD PRACTICES:**

- Manifest: `order-archive-snapshot-l24.yaml` (snapshot + restore PVC; check Pod is optional).
- Do **not** delete the original archive claim on the happy path.
- Work only in your lab namespace (not `default`).

hints: Your namespace is in the lab chrome and in $LEARNER_NS — kubectl already defaults there.
Wait until order-archive-pvc is Bound (archive-seed Pod) before creating the VolumeSnapshot.
Restored PVC must set storageClassName: gp2 plus the VolumeSnapshot dataSource.
Submit only needs the VolumeSnapshot + restore PVC wired correctly — the check Pod is optional.
Work only in your lab namespace (not default).
Read SPEC carefully, apply your YAML, then Submit.
problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Snapshot and Restore Order Archives

Take VolumeSnapshot `order-archive-snap` of `order-archive-pvc`, then restore into a new PVC `order-archive-pvc-restore` on **`gp2`**.

Docs: [DevSetu Blog — Volumes, PVs, PVCs, and StorageClasses](/play/devops-engineer/kubernetes/read/volumes-pvs-pvcs-storageclasses) · [Volume Snapshots](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volume-snapshots/)

## Solution YAML (required)

Save as `order-archive-snapshot-l24.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: snapshot.storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: VolumeSnapshot
metadata:
  name: order-archive-snap
spec:
  volumeSnapshotClassName: quickbyte-snapclass
  source:
    persistentVolumeClaimName: order-archive-pvc
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: order-archive-pvc-restore
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 500Mi
  storageClassName: gp2
  dataSource:
    name: order-archive-snap
    kind: VolumeSnapshot
    apiGroup: snapshot.storage.k8s.io
```

## Optional check Pod (not graded)

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: archive-restore-check
spec:
  containers:
    - name: check
      image: busybox:1.36
      command: ["sleep", "3600"]
      volumeMounts:
        - name: restore
          mountPath: /restore
  volumes:
    - name: restore
      persistentVolumeClaim:
        claimName: order-archive-pvc-restore
```

## Declarative

```bash
kubectl apply -f order-archive-snapshot-l24.yaml
kubectl get volumesnapshot order-archive-snap
kubectl get pvc order-archive-pvc-restore
```

Confirm the snapshot and restore PVC objects match the SPEC, then **Submit**. Do not delete the original archive claim. The check Pod and Bound/readyToUse status are optional.
